contexts.text: Adam supposed to mean the first man created. AC 1013.
By Adam in Paradise the Angels perceive the Most Ancient Church, not the Church [itself], but the faith in the Lord of that Church.

When the Most Ancient Church is called Adam it signifies that man was made out of the ground, or that man was made from non-man by regeneration... this is the origin of the name, and this is the signification of it. AC 479.
The Hebrew word Adam signifies man, and that Church is not properly called Adam, but Man. Explained.
Adam is ground. AC 566.
Adam, or Man = the Most Ancient Church.
General article. AC 1115. AC 2930. AC 4454.

There are two Hebrew words that signify man, Adam and Enosh; and by the man who is called Adam is understood the man of the Celestial Church; but by the man who is called Enosh, the man of the Spiritual Church.
By Adam or Man and Eve his wife is there understood a new Church.
Adam was so called from the ground, for by him was signified the man of the Celestial Church, or the Church that is in good.
Man or Adam and his wife = a Celestial Church.
Man in Genesis = the Church itself, in like manner ground, from which Adam was named.

Some imagine that Adam was in such freedom that he could love God and be wise from himself... but this is an error... wherefore when he wished to be wise and to love from his own, he fell from wisdom and love, and was cast out of Paradise.
That the wisest of men, Adam and his wife, suffered themselves to be seduced. General article.
Adam and his wife do not mean the first men created in this world, but the men of the Most Ancient Church. DP 313. TCR 466. TCR 520:2. AE 617:15.
The state of innocence in which were Adam and Eve.
That hereditary evil is from Adam is an error. Explained.
The condemnation of Eve = the condemnation of their own voluntary, and the condemnation of Adam = the condemnation of their own intellectual.
The Most Ancient Church is described by Adam and Eve his wife.

They therefore are in enormous error who believe Adam to have been wise and to have done what is good from himself, and that this was his state of integrity; when yet Adam himself was cursed for that belief.
This was the sin of Adam. Explained.
It is said that the evil into which man is born is hereditarily from Adam, but it is from the parents... The reason why it is believed that the guilt of Adam is inscribed on all mankind... BE 111.
Many have believed that Adam and Eve do not mean the first men created... (These passages show) that the earth was inhabited before Adam.
Adam signifies the ground of the earth.
On the pre-adamites who were regenerated and called Adam.
They said that Adam could do what is good from himself.
Adam and Edom are both derived from red.
Hence Adam was so called from the ground.
On the Adamic or Most Ancient Church on this earth. General article.
